title: NKIP-0005 cashtag tag v1 (as written)
description: WRITER form only: what a writer emits. Readers are more lenient (see the spec and the event vectors): they upper-case the ticker (so ["cashtag","xmr"] still reads as XMR), a missing or unknown mode reads as compact, a bad asset id is ignored. Rules a schema can't express (the ticker must appear as $TICKER in the content, asset-to-ticker binding, chain-slug table) are in the spec.
